title: papaver pyrenaicum subsp. sendtneri
intro: Papaver pyrenaicum subsp. sendtneri, commonly known as the Pyrenean poppy, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the poppy family (Papaveraceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation and acting as an analgesic. The therapeutic actions of Pyrenean poppy include its use as a pain reliever and an antispasmodic agent, which helps to relieve muscle spasms and cramps. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
